references.title_original: Fast Single-Atom Preparation in Optical Tweezers via Rydberg Blockade
references.citation: Y. Li, V. M. Hughes, M. Peper, Y. Bao, C. Li, S. Bissenali, and J. D. Thompson, Fast single-atom preparation in optical tweezers via Rydberg blockade, PRX Quantum 7, 043019 (2026).
references.read_scope: Final published PDF all 11 pages, including integrated Appendices A–D and references; official APS metadata/abstract/popular summary and Crossref metadata. Key pages 4 and 6 rendered and visually inspected. No independent experiment or numerical rerun.
references.availability: Published data availability p7: no publicly available research data or software; available from authors on reasonable request. No author contact made. No separate supplemental file identified in checked official links; Appendices A–D are integrated in the final PDF.
important_conditions: Ground-state two-photon removal: P(N>1)=1% at 18 × 3.6 us = 64.8 us; final P(N=1)=58.2(2)% of tweezers, not survival conditional on initially having one atom.
Main ground-state comparison initial mean occupancy 2.3, LAC under same initial conditions/trap depth takes 10 ms and reaches 53.9(2)% filling at 1% multi-atom occupancy.
Apparatus 4 × 25 traps, but Rydberg-dynamics analysis selects 50 traps along beam propagation.
Metastable 3P0 result: 74.8(3)% filling; 11 × 7.2 us = 79.2 us removal to 1%; full sequence 6.6 ms including 4 ms cooling and 2.5 ms state preparation. Characterized in 1D array of 7 atoms.
Additional two-body loss unresolved. 99%/99.9% deterministic loading in Appendix D is simulated with assumed future loss parameters, not demonstrated.

references.title_original: Modeling Logical Gates and Readout of Superconducting Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill Qubits
references.citation: M. H. Shaw, A. C. Doherty, and A. L. Grimsmo, Modeling logical gates and readout of superconducting Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill qubits, PRX Quantum 7, 043020 (2026).
references.read_scope: Final published PDF all 46 pages, including integrated Appendices A–H, tables, figure captions, and references; official APS metadata/abstract/popular summary, Crossref metadata, and arXiv 2403.02396 version-history page. Key pages 6, 14 and 16 rendered and visually inspected. Derivations read, not independently symbolically rederived or numerically reproduced.
references.availability: No author-linked public dataset or code repository identified in the final PDF, checked APS landing-page links, or arXiv record. No separate SI identified; Appendices A–H are integrated. This is a limited negative search, not a claim that no code exists.
important_conditions: Approximate finite-energy codestates e^(-Delta^2 n); square/hexagonal geometry; ideal versus approximate teleportation QEC have different decoder patches and error floors.

About two orders improvement at Delta_dB=12 in ideal-QEC Clifford examples, roughly one order when approximate teleportation-QEC codestates are included (p5–9). Not a measured hardware speedup or achieved gate fidelity.

Loss-as-displacement approximation includes coupled envelope/loss contribution gamma^2/(8Delta^2), is not a universal identity for arbitrary physical states. Relative error under 1% in stated 10<Delta_dB<18, gamma<10% regime. Dephasing is non-Gaussian; critical-region estimates can fail.

Readout proposals: single-mode amplification or a separate low-Q readout mode. At physical eta=.75 and g=10 × 2pi MHz, estimated effective eta=.85 after .45 us or .92 after .63 us; assumes negligible GKP-mode loss on t <<1/gamma, optimized kappa, vacuum ancilla. These are theoretical examples; feasible g and on/off leakage remain open.
Autonomous/dissipative QEC transfer, complete noisy gate implementation, and integration with outer code remain future work in this paper.

references.title_original: Constructing Arbitrary Coherent Rearrangements in Optical Lattices
references.citation: A. Roth, L. Qiu, T. Hilker, T. Franz, and P. M. Preiss, Constructing arbitrary coherent rearrangements in optical lattices, PRX Quantum 7, 043021 (2026).
references.read_scope: Final published PDF all 15 pages, including integrated Appendices A–C and references; Crossref final-record metadata. Key pages 7 and 10 rendered and visually inspected. Official Zenodo API metadata and all 11 deposited files downloaded with MD5 verification; README read, CSV structures and selected first/last records inspected. No simulation executed or code rerun.
references.availability: Data availability p11 cites Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23325914. The open CC BY4.0 record has 10 CSV files plus README. README states full code available upon reasonable request; no author request made.
important_conditions: Single-particle motional unitary on N orthogonal ground-band modes; spinless non-interacting limit with residual interaction analysis. Arbitrary single-particle U(N) is not arbitrary interacting many-body computation.
Clements gate count N(N-1)/2 and depth N in 1D. A depth layer comprises two global tunneling pulses and two local phase layers, with calibrated spatial resolution required.

2D HVH on L × L, N=L² modes: needs auxiliary columns up to L−1, total extended width at worst 2L−1; depth O(5L)=O(sqrt(N)), gate count O(3N sqrt(N)). The sublinear statement concerns depth, not total gates, classical compilation, or all end-to-end resources.

Errors: global X assumed ideal with leading detuning captured as Z phase error; random phase multiplicative noise, nearest-neighbor crosstalk, residual interactions numerically studied. Fidelity is state fidelity per mode except full Fock-space interaction comparison.

For example N=10 DFT, n=10 bosons requires U_int/t approximately <=1.36e-3 for infidelity <1e-3 in the modeled sequence. Estimated N=10 sequence about6ms under proposed Li lattice controls, not measured. Larger N needs coherence, broad beams/inhomogeneity compensation, and phase/crosstalk stability.
references.source_class: theory, compilation and classical numerical error analysis; no new lattice experiment

edition_notes: 수집·메일·소셜 경위와 내부 메모를 삭제했다. 손상된 상관 기호를 복원하고 원제·전 저자·판본의 APS 서지를 최초 인용순 [1]-[6]으로 수록했다. 원 논문 PDF·도판은 재배포하지 않는다.
[1] 88%=200/228은 AI referee의 major-issue 지적률이다. 사용·제안 논문을 검색한 표본이며, 동분야 AI 130편(84%)과 control 50편(76%)을 구분한다. 이 228편 중 실행한 최신 범용 model의 출시→첫 arXiv 제출 간격을 산출한 189편의 중앙값은 96일이다.
[2] N=500·1000의 0.956±0.003·0.870±0.003은 최종 local search 전 값이며 10 instances의 평균±SEM이다. N=40 정련 후 값 및 별도 N=16 finite-sampling 모사와 구분한다. 성능 실험은 유한 repair-risk budget을 적용하지 않았다.
[3] N(r,E)는 per-spin 누적 LDOS다. 밀도 blind는 OV 혼합·점유 교차가 없는 조건에서 해석한다. Table 12의 50 stable-id SCF 초기화는 minao 대비 반복 수 비 0.6713·추론 포함 시간 비 0.8505를 보고했다. 기존 학습 모형도 0.6732·0.8619로 비슷해 새 loss의 고유한 가속과 구분한다.
[4] 58.2(2)%는 최종 single-atom filling이다. 64.8 μs는 제거 펄스 구간이다. metastable 74.8(3)%의 제거 구간 79.2 μs와 냉각·준비를 포함한 전체 6.6 ms를 구분한다.
[5] ΔdB=12 Clifford 예의 decoder 개선은 이상적 QEC에서 약 2 orders, 근사 teleportation QEC까지 넣으면 약 1 order다. 장치에서 측정한 성능이 아니다.
[6] O(√N)은 N=L² 모드와 최대 L−1 보조열을 쓰는 HVH 회로 깊이다. 총 gate 수나 전체 실행비용과 구분한다. 실제 격자 장치 실행은 수행하지 않은 이론·수치 결과다.
